symptom: The freshly built backend container repeatedly restarts and remains unhealthy during Nest application initialization.
evidence: Bounded backend logs report UnknownExportException because AuthModule exports JwtAuthGuard although that guard is absent from the module providers list.

root_cause.summary: finalsource/be/src/modules/auth/auth.module.ts exports JwtAuthGuard but does not register JwtAuthGuard in providers.

actions_attempted: Validated Compose configuration and Docker daemon reachability.
Built fresh backend and frontend production images successfully.
Avoided an unrelated occupied host port 3306 by keeping the Compose database port internal-only and using unused application host ports.
Captured bounded service status and backend startup logs.
resolution: JwtAuthGuard was added to AuthModule.providers. Fresh startup no longer raises UnknownExportException and proceeds to the independently recorded missing-domain-table database blocker DEP-20260831-001.
reusable_resolution: Register JwtAuthGuard in AuthModule.providers before exporting it, rebuild the backend image, and verify all service healthchecks.
prevention: Require Nest modules to register each exported provider and include a bounded application-startup observation after production image builds.
